description: Deterministic tests for the retained Windows Codex Router product.

selections.testNamePattern: ^(signed-in picker overlay cannot hide Codex native base entries|Switchyard inherits the native Codex request and compaction contract|GLM-5\.3-Flash replaces the native prompt with its concise Codex contract|routed models are native v2 spawn-agent model overrides|native catalog merge preserves account visibility and bundled-only models|native listed models retain the installed catalog's collaboration capability)$

^(plain Codex provider routes accept the caller key as a bearer token|router preserves native auth and isolates every external route|router relays encrypted Codex subagent payloads before external routing|router fails closed when an encrypted subagent payload cannot be relayed|Switchyard preserves native requests and leaves compaction on the native backend|router repairs malformed OpenRouter GLM-5\.3-Flash message envelopes after LiteLLM translation)$

^(no session on disk means no fallback rather than an error|a signed-in session stays private until the user authorizes sharing once|shared native session reconstructs the FedRAMP header from Codex identity claims|the current Codex session authenticates only its own bearer without enabling sharing|the current Codex API key authenticates requests but never becomes a shared session|direct Codex authentication uses actual expiry rather than fallback skew|sharing cannot be enabled before the user signs in|status reports presence, never the credential|a session with no access token is not a session|the fallback can be switched off|the environment override is explicit in both directions|an unrecognized consent marker fails closed|an empty or malformed native catalog publishes nothing|the router's own caller key is not an upstream credential|a substituted caller's payload is made acceptable to the native endpoint|the expiry claim is read without the token leaving the module|an expired session is withheld rather than spent on a certain 401|status reports the remaining life, never the token|the bearer parser is linear and rejects the shapes it should)$
^OpenRouter GLM owns its Codex prompt and Novita provider policy$

^(flattenNamespaceTools flattens every namespace, including MCP ones|full inventory survives merge \+ flatten with nothing dropped|response transform restores flattened calls to the native namespace shape|response transform drops a spawn-agent model override not offered by the tool schema|every flattened app tool reaches the provider with an object root|custom-tool bridge maps apply_patch definitions and paired history losslessly|native custom-tool streams accept LiteLLM content-wrapped legacy argument events)$

^(routed request flattens every namespace to the gateway and restores calls to the client|non-streaming routed responses restore namespace calls before client dispatch|routed tool_search history declares discovered tools and restores their calls|Responses-native routed providers inherit the model on fresh local thread calls)$
^(the Windows operational scripts parse in Windows PowerShell|the Windows restart helper uses the supported service transaction)$
^(every detached worker is spawned without a console window|Windows start uses the managed service and keeps foreground explicit)$
